summary: Master programme governance and sponsor effectiveness with practical tools, templates, and reporting methods. Book intermediate training with TrainingCred.
lede: Programme governance gives programme managers, sponsors, and PMO professionals practical ways to clarify decision rights, oversight, and escalation. The course addresses controlling execution and turning programme evidence into leadership decisions, with practice in drafting governance charters and sponsor plans, managing RAID and dependencies, and building reporting packs, assurance checklists, and dashboards for oversight.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who already work inside programme delivery, sponsor oversight, or PMO governance and need sharper methods to control execution, escalation, and reporting. The content fits people who must turn programme evidence into leadership decisions, not just prepare status updates.
prerequisites: You should bring prior exposure to programme delivery, project oversight, PMO reporting, or executive governance meetings. A laptop is recommended for working on templates, and familiarity with Excel and PowerPoint will help you complete the reporting exercises efficiently.
